leadText: What? HIYAMA is evolving! (Japanese: おや!?ヒヤマのようすが…！ What!? HIYAMA is evolving!) is the sixth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on November 24, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
plainText:
What? HIYAMA is evolving! (Japanese: おや!?ヒヤマのようすが…！ What!? HIYAMA is evolving!) is the sixth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on November 24, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
 

==Plot==
==Major events==
Madoka battles Hiyama in a link battle and wins.
Hiyama is promoted to ADventure's creative sector.

==Characters==
===Humans===
Madoka Akagi
Kageaki Hiyama
Koichi Yadoya
Kazuchika Kogusuri
Yoko Meguro
Yuki Koide (flashback)
Masako
Sora Karasawa
Kōji Kogusuri (flashback)
Syo Sawamura
Kenji Ebiwara
Announcer

===Pokémon===

==Trivia==
The rules of the battle between Madoka Akagi and Kageaki Hiyama were as follows:
Level 50 and under
No Legendaries
Limit of one repeat species per team
The use of on your final Pokémon is prohibited
The use of Sleep inducing moves is limited to three times

===Dub edits===
